name: cona
description: Token-efficient code navigation: read one symbol instead of a whole file, search code semantically, and edit with syntax verification. Bundles the cona skill, the read/grep advisory hooks, auto-reindexing, and the MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read one symbol instead of a whole file
interface.longDescription: cona indexes your project into a tree-sitter symbol tree so Codex can pull a single function, class, or method instead of dumping whole files into context. Adds semantic code search, syntax-verified edits, and hooks that steer large reads toward the cheap query.
defaultPrompt: Orient me in this codebase with cona
Show me the login function without reading the whole file
What calls this symbol, and what would break if I change it?
